title: Schedule View shows the calendar with all technicians
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Schedule View only.
custom_steps:
1. Log in and open Schedule from the top navigation.
  2. Look at the appointments on the calendar.
custom_expected:
The Schedule page opens.

Appointments for all technicians are shown, not just the user's own.

There are no create, edit or delete options on the appointments.
evidence: UI: a role with Schedule View (ZZAUTOTEST Viewer) opens /schedule and the calendar renders. Schedule appears in top nav.
